# strict schema equality is brittle

The test asserts exact equality between Base.metadata.tables and the EXPECTED_TABLES set. This strictness can cause test failures if benign or tooling-introduced tables (e.g., bookkeeping tables) appear, requiring conscious updates to the test for any addition.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_storage.py` — `tests.test_storage.test_schema_declares_exactly_expected_tables`
